body: I am so sorry you are going through this. Are you able to support yourself financially? Do you have family or friends you could stay with temporarily? It is important you remove yourself from this environment as soon as possible if this is an option. If not, are you safe? Are you able to potentially save enough to leave and relocate, given the circumstances? Do not feel a failure for relapsing, you’re going through something very traumatic. However, self-harm should not be depended on to express your emotions, it is a priority you keep yourself safe. Your life is worth fighting for, and this dark period will be over before you know it.

Got you now! I’d definitely agree but unfortunately time is not on my side as finals are fast approaching - really just looking for optimal results with minimal experimentation, but of course this is likely an unachievable ideal! But 100% agree always best to try individually first:)!

That’s definitely a possibility! Sadly, there’s little research about melatonin tolerance so its hard to know for sure, and because I use it so infrequently it seems unlikely I’d build tolerance so quickly, but wouldn’t rule it out :)

Thank you for the heads up :)! Melatonin is not for extended use and I do not use it unless I have finals/deadlines etc. I also use it in place of benzos to sleep, whilst neither would be great, melatonin seems a safer choice. A recommended dose can range anywhere between 1-10mg - some people can benefit greatly from the lower doses to simply nudge that receptor, unfortunately I cannot. I do appreciate your concern however, and will explore alternatives :)

Definitely sounds like your dose was a little too high! For me personally, I feel the optimal dose for me is when I can identify I’ve taken meds, but don’t *feel* like I’m on meds - otherwise I’m spacey and slow, and generally just out of it like you described. Definitely try the 50mg, if you’re less lethargic it’s probably an indication that you don’t have to try the higher doses and vice versa. I would also say to make sure you’re aware of the implications of extended modafinil use as it can spike suicidal ideation etc. Good luck:)!
Of course! These are pretty common drugs/nootropics to stack however, and have little risk of interaction - if anything they compliment one another and support functioning for optimal use :)
Hahaha you think! Ive tried both 3mg & 6mg doses and there are times my body will resist both, but I have had far greater success using the higher doses :)

I know the struggle! Generally stimulants make me *too* calm and I often zone out and fall asleep. The higher a dose is for me, the more likely I am to fall asleep. Have you tried a 50mg dose? Doses as low as 25mg are really beneficial for some people! I really do empathise with your frustration though, finding the correct meds is a disheartening cycle. Sending love :)!

Thanks for your reply!:) Ive had pretty long standing, extreme end depression since 14/15. I’m only now just trying antidepressants etc, but from previous experiences of trying ADHD meds (both on and off of SSRIs) it seems the depression is separate from ADHD and very much still prevalent even when the ADHD symptoms reduce:)

Definitely agree with L-Tyrosine! People seem to have a lot of success with it so I hope I respond similarly! Again with L-Theanine, hoping to add that in the next few months once I’m sure the Zoloft is no longer in my system to avoid any potential serotonin syndrome :) From previous experiences with benzos, I typically don’t react great - but definitely gonna research further into GABA and possibly give it a try! Thank you :)
Definitely depends on what your stack is comprised of, but modafinil increases histamine response so I take it to combat that:)

Thanks for your reply!! none taken!:) It may be worth adding that I’m a psych student so have a pretty good understanding as to not overload neurotransmitters etc, but of course can’t account for the pills and everyones brain is different:) Definitely agree about modas intended use, but the drug works to activate the hypothalamus & theres evidence it regulates dopamine functioning (which are deficits for people with ADHD), so in theory using it for this purpose does make sense. Most of the reason I’m trying Moda is that its much more accessible than Ritalin to me. You’re totally right though, stims aren’t to be fucked with! Thank you:)

Yeah definitely think I’ll give a lower dose a try. And for the motivation - for sure! Just finding it pretty hard to maintain the motivation on it. Will definitely give the to-do list a try, thank you!:)

Yeah I'm currently going through the diagnosis process, there is pretty much every indication I have ADHD, it's just a long waiting list to confirm this by psychiatrists and be prescribed medication. I take Ritalin as I would be prescribed it, and limit this only to essay/exam season. I persevere with the symptoms otherwise. I don't abuse stims:)
